brand_motto: Knowledge First. Excellence Second. Clarity Always. Imagination Where It Matters.

heading.usage: Used for Headings, Titles, Dashboard primary metrics, and Hero sections. Communicates museum-quality authority, permanence, and enterprise trust.

body.usage: Used for UI elements, paragraphs, tables, forms, and dense data displays. Prioritizes maximum readability and clarity.

rules: H1 (Hero/Main Heading): text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl with tracking-tight. NEVER exceed text-6xl.
Never center default headings; prioritize clear left alignment for reading and logical flow.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Lato, or Open Sans. They dilute the enterprise museum-quality standard.

hierarchy_rules: 1. PRIMARY (Navy): The foundation. Use for branding, headers, dashboards, sidebar navigation, major backgrounds, and interface structure. Establishes serious enterprise trust.
2. SECONDARY (Gold): Verified excellence. Use for Treasure Standard™ badges, certifications, verified status, highlights, and progress metrics. Gold should NEVER overpower Navy.
3. NEUTRAL (White): Clarity and readability. Use for learning pages, documents, cards, and content backgrounds. Creates breathing room and reduces cognitive load.
4. SIGNATURE ACCENT (Purple): Inspire curiosity. Use SPARINGLY. Apply to key CTAs, interactive elements, learning pathways, and discovery moments. Guide attention rather than dominate.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Trust before excitement; Simplicity before clutter; Professionalism before decoration.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: p-8 to p-12 for major section wrappers.
layout_and_spacing.card_padding: p-6 internal padding for content blocks.
layout_and_spacing.grids: Use Mode B: 'Control Room' grid for dashboards (Manufacturing Command Center, Evidence Metrics). Dense, scanable, structural: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strict left-alignment for dense content, data, and forms to ensure cognitive ease.

components.navigation_shell: Sidebar/Header MUST be Deep Navy (bg-primary) with White text (text-primary-foreground) to anchor the enterprise system.
components.cards: White surface (bg-card), sharp/subtle border-radius (rounded-sm or rounded-md), very subtle 1px border (border-border). Avoid heavy or muddy drop shadows. Museum-quality flat surfaces.

buttons.discovery_cta: Royal Purple (bg-accent text-accent-foreground) - Use sparingly for major conversions/publish actions.

components.badges_and_chips: Gold background for 'Verified', 'Treasure Standard', or success. Navy background for 'Draft', 'Architecture', or standard tags.
components.tables: Strict structural lines. Clear padding. Avoid distracting row-striping. Professional and un-cluttered.

motion.philosophy: Motion should ONLY signify state changes and guide workflow, never entertain.
motion.transitions: Use subtle fade-ins. transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out.
motion.hover_states: -translate-y-[1px] on cards with a slight shadow increase. Simple background darkening on buttons. No bouncy effects.

assets.rules: SVGs must be used purely as code components. No image files or generations should be used. The SVGs dynamically adapt colors using Tailwind's 'text-primary' (Navy) and 'text-secondary' (Gold) utility classes.

testing_guidelines.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Crucial for enterprise reliability.
testing_guidelines.scope: Applies to buttons, links, form inputs, menus, error messages, metric cards, and confirmation text.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: The codebase uses standard Javascript (.js), NOT Typescript (.tsx). Ensure all React component modifications are written in .js.
Apply the exact HSL token values provided in `colors.shadcn_css_variables` to your globals.css to establish the permanent QRU hierarchy.
Update tailwind.config.js to import and set the fonts: 'Playfair Display' for serif/headings, 'Manrope' for sans/body.
Implement the Layout Shell: Ensure the Sidebar Navigation uses the Navy background (`bg-primary`) to ground the application.

Implement the specific Enterprise features (Manufacturing Command Center, Evidence Metrics, Quality Gates, Knowledge Architecture, Publishing Connectors) using the strict 'Control Room' grid layout and the precise color hierarchy. NO trends, NO clutter.
Build reusable `QRUShield` and `TreasureStandardSeal` functional components using the provided SVG strings. Ensure they accept className props for sizing.
For all interactive elements throughout the app, meticulously add the `data-testid` attribute as specified in testing_guidelines.
Only use Purple (`bg-accent`) for highly specific discovery or major interaction moments (e.g., 'Authorize OAuth', 'Publish Connectors').
